## R Markdown

Function to invert colors as needed
```{r}
invert_color <- function(color) {
  
  # 1. Convert the input color (name or hex) to RGB values
  # col2rgb returns a matrix, with values from 0-255
  rgb_matrix <- col2rgb(color)
  
  # 2. Invert the values by subtracting from 255
  inverted_matrix <- 255 - rgb_matrix
  
  # 3. Convert the new RGB values back to a hex code
  # The rgb() function expects inputs from 0-255
  new_hex <- rgb(
    red = inverted_matrix[1,],
    green = inverted_matrix[2,],
    blue = inverted_matrix[3,],
    maxColorValue = 255
  )
  
  return(new_hex)
}
```

Parking Sign
```{r cars}
draw_parking_sign <- function(primary_color = "#00539F", 
                              scale = 1.0, 
                              font_scale = 0.20) {
  
  # Declare base variables
  base_width <- 0.5  
  base_height <- 0.5  
  
  # Scale based on input parameter
  final_width <- base_width * scale
  final_height <- base_height * scale * 1.3  
  
  # Create a new page and set font
  grid.newpage()
  sign_white <- "white"
  sign_font <- "Arial"
  
  pushViewport(viewport(width = final_width, height = final_height))
  
  # Make the rectangle representing the parking sign
  grid.roundrect(
    gp = gpar(
      fill = primary_color, 
      col = sign_white,   
      lwd = 10           
    ),
    r = unit(0.05, "snpc") 
  )
  
  # Determines where to place the text
  v_height_pts <- convertHeight(unit(1, "npc"), "points", valueOnly = TRUE)
  dynamic_fontsize <- v_height_pts * font_scale
  
  #Add the text to the parking sign
  grid.text("PARKING",
    x = 0.5, y = 0.6,
    gp = gpar(
      col = sign_white,
      fontfamily = sign_font,
      fontface = "bold",
      fontsize = dynamic_fontsize
    )
  )
  
  popViewport()
}

draw_parking_sign("red", scale = 1)
```
House
```{r}
draw_house <- function(house_color = "red", scale = 1.0, show_grid = FALSE) {
  
  # Declare base variables
  base_size <- 0.5
  final_size <- base_size * scale
  
  # Create a new page and set font
  grid.newpage()
  door_color <- "darkgray"
  window_color <- invert_color(house_color)
  sign_text_color <- "white"
  
  # Crates viewport
  pushViewport(viewport(
    x = 0.5, y = 0.5, 
    width = final_size,
    height = final_size,
    xscale = c(0, 8),  
    yscale = c(0, 8)  
  ))
  
  # Shows grid based on input
  if (show_grid) {
    grid.xaxis(at = 0:8, label = FALSE, gp = gpar(col = "lightgray"))
    grid.yaxis(at = 0:8, label = FALSE, gp = gpar(col = "lightgray"))
  }
  
  # Make rectangle representing base of house
  grid.rect(
    x = 4, y = 2.5,    
    width = 6, height = 4,
    default.units = "native",
    gp = gpar(fill = house_color, col = "black", lwd = 2)
  )
  
  # Make the roof of the house
  x_roof <- c(1, 7, 4)  
  y_roof <- c(4.5, 4.5, 7)
  grid.polygon(
    x = x_roof, y = y_roof,
    default.units = "native",
    gp = gpar(fill = "brown", col = "black", lwd = 2)
  )
  
  # Make the sign on top of the house
  sign_y_pos <- 7.5  
  sign_height <- 0.8  
  grid.rect(
    x = 4,
    y = sign_y_pos,
    width = 4,
    height = sign_height,
    default.units = "native",
    gp = gpar(fill = house_color, col = "black", lwd = 2)  
  )
  
  # Add the text for the sign
  grid.text(
    "HOUSE",
    x = 4,
    y = sign_y_pos,
    default.units = "native",
    gp = gpar(col = sign_text_color, fontface = "bold", cex = 1.8 * scale)  # White text
  )
  
  # Add the door to the house
  grid.rect(
    x = 4, y = 1.25,    
    width = 1.5, height = 1.5,
    default.units = "native",
    gp = gpar(fill = door_color, col = "black")
  )
  
  # Add the window to the house
  grid.rect(
    x = 2.5, y = 3,      
    width = 1.5, height = 1.5,
    default.units = "native",
    gp = gpar(fill = window_color, col = "black")
  )
  
  popViewport()
}

draw_house("darkgreen", scale = 1)

```

Road
```{r}
draw_road <- function(road_color = "darkgray", scale = 1.0) {
  
  # Determine road stripe sign
  line_color <- ifelse(road_color == "yellow", "black", "yellow")
  
  # Make road size
  base_size <- 0.5  
  final_size <- base_size * scale
  
  # Make new page and set sidewalk color
  grid.newpage()
  sidewalk_color <- "lightgray"
  
  # Push viewport
  pushViewport(viewport(
    x = 0.5, y = 0.5, 
    width = final_size,
    height = final_size,
    xscale = c(0, 10),
    yscale = c(0, 10)
  ))
  
  # Makes the road
  grid.rect(
    x = 5, y = 4, 
    width = 10, height = 2,
    default.units = "native",
    gp = gpar(fill = road_color, col = "black", lwd = 2)
  )
  
  # Makes the stripes on the road
  line_segments_x <- seq(0.5, 9.5, by = 1)
  
  for (start_x in line_segments_x) {
    grid.rect(
      x = start_x, 
      y = 4, 
      width = 0.5, 
      height = 0.1,
      just = "left", 
      default.units = "native",
      gp = gpar(fill = line_color, col = NA)
    )
  }
  
  # Makes the sidewalk
  grid.rect(
    x = 5, y = 5.5, width = 10, height = 1,
    default.units = "native",
    gp = gpar(fill = sidewalk_color, col = "black")
  )

  popViewport()
}

draw_road("darkgreen", 1)
```


Hotel
```{r}
draw_hotel <- function(hotel_color = "#2B3A67", scale = 1.0) {
  
  grid.newpage()
  
  # Declare base variables
  building_color <- hotel_color
  roof_color <- "#888888"
  window_color <- "#FFD700"
  door_color <- "#5a3825"
  sign_text_color <- "white"
  
  # Declare hotel's size and  scale it based on input parameter
  center_x <- 0.5
  center_y <- 0.45
  building_width <- 0.5 * scale  
  building_height <- 0.5 * scale  
  
  # Makes the hotel's rectangular center
  grid.rect(
    x = unit(center_x, "npc"), 
    y = unit(center_y, "npc"),
    width = unit(building_width, "npc"),
    height = unit(building_height, "npc"),
    gp = gpar(fill = building_color, col = "black")
  )
  
  # Makes the hotel's roof
  roof_y_base <- center_y + building_height/2
  roof_y_peak <- roof_y_base + 0.15 * scale
  
  grid.polygon(
    x = unit(c(center_x - building_width/2, center_x, center_x + building_width/2), "npc"),
    y = unit(c(roof_y_base, roof_y_peak, roof_y_base), "npc"),
    gp = gpar(fill = roof_color, col = "black")
  )
  
  # Makes the hotel's door
  door_y_center <- center_y - 0.175 * scale 
  
  grid.rect(
    x = unit(center_x, "npc"), 
    y = unit(door_y_center, "npc"),
    width = unit(0.1 * scale, "npc"), 
    height = unit(0.15 * scale, "npc"),
    gp = gpar(fill = door_color, col = "black")
  )
  
  # Makes the hotel's windows
  x_positions <- seq(center_x - 0.15*scale, center_x + 0.15*scale, length.out = 3)
  y_positions <- seq(center_y + 0.05*scale, center_y + 0.18*scale, length.out = 2)
  
  for (x in x_positions) {
    for (y in y_positions) {
      grid.rect(
        x = unit(x, "npc"), 
        y = unit(y, "npc"),
        width = unit(0.08 * scale, "npc"), 
        height = unit(0.1 * scale, "npc"),
        gp = gpar(fill = window_color, col = "black")
      )
    }
  }
  
  # Makes the hotel's sign
  sign_y_pos <- roof_y_peak - 0.05 * scale 
  
  grid.rect(
    x = unit(center_x, "npc"), 
    y = unit(sign_y_pos, "npc"),
    width = unit(0.3 * scale, "npc"), 
    height = unit(0.07 * scale, "npc"),
    gp = gpar(fill = building_color, col = "black", lwd = 2)
  )
  
  # Adds text to the sign          
  grid.text(
    "HOTEL", 
    x = unit(center_x, "npc"), 
    y = unit(sign_y_pos, "npc"),
    gp = gpar(col = sign_text_color, fontface = "bold", cex = 1.8 * scale)
  )
}

draw_hotel("darkgreen", scale = 1)
```

Office
```{r}
draw_office <- function(office_color = "gray80", scale = 1.0) {
  
  grid.newpage()
  
  # Declare base variables
  building_width <- 0.5 * scale  
  building_height <- 0.5 * scale 
  center_x <- 0.5
  center_y <- 0.5
  
  # Make the rectangular center of the office
  grid.rect(
    x = center_x, y = center_y,
    width = building_width, height = building_height,
    gp = gpar(fill = office_color, col = "black")
  )
    
  
  # Makes the sign of the office
  sign_height <- building_height * 0.12
  sign_y_pos <- center_y + building_height/2 + sign_height/2
  
  grid.rect(
    x = center_x,
    y = sign_y_pos,
    width = building_width * 0.7,
    height = sign_height,
    gp = gpar(fill = office_color, col = "black")
  )
  
  # Adds text to the office sign
  grid.text(
    "OFFICE",
    x = center_x,
    y = sign_y_pos,
    gp = gpar(col = "white", fontface = "bold", fontsize = 15 * scale)  # Scale the font
  )
  
  # Makes the windows of the office
  window_width <- building_width / 5
  window_height <- building_height / 6
  
  for (i in 1:3) {
    for (j in 1:3) {
      window_x <- center_x - building_width/3 + (j-1)*(building_width/3)
      window_y <- center_y - building_height/4 + (i-1)*(building_height/4)
      
      grid.rect(
        x = window_x,
        y = window_y,
        width = window_width, 
        height = window_height,
        gp = gpar(fill = "lightblue", col = "black")
      )
    }
  }
}

draw_office("darkgreen", scale = 1)
```
